MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB hub felt useful because several of my past purchases help connect computer peripherals, and its individual switches offer practical control over connected devices.",
    "The Ethernet cables and wired earbuds relate to my Ethernet adapter and headset purchases, so I can see why they might interest me even though I do not need them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The streaming stick, smart speaker and doorbell serve needs I have not shown; buying computer adapters does not mean I am looking for entertainment or home security devices.",
    "The drives and memory card require a storage need I have not expressed, and buying a tablet mount does not mean I want another tablet.",
    "The Ethernet cables fit the kind of accessory I use, but six one-foot cables require a particular setup I do not currently have a reason to build."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in specific computer accessories seems to have been broadened into interest in electronics generally.",
    "A shared connection such as USB seems to count too much: a USB backup drive solves a different problem from adding ports or connecting to Ethernet."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases suggest occasional, specific connection needs rather than a continuing desire to buy new devices.",
    "Practical details matter to me: the hub's switches are useful, its USB 2.0 speed is a limitation, and the Ethernet cables' short length and pack size make them hard to justify.",
    "Something can match my interests without prompting a purchase; I rarely interact unless it addresses a clear need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized some of my interest in practical connectivity accessories, but stretched it into broader device and storage interests without a clear current need."
}
